question: Does an explicitly separated Solsoe-held geographic block support new zero-compatible spatial predictions with the retained coupled count/PPE working-law uncertainty, while preserving forbidden reverse-block roles and undefined mass?

geography.rule: Any scientific source in the held geographic block is forbidden. Every required allowed source, including regional KRAG, must additionally pass full-precision WGS84 centre distance minus both radii and both uncertainty allowances >=20km. No source removal, alternate anchor, reduced footprint or single-local fallback. KRAG is source only; no invented target or local rings.
geography.independent_geometry: WGS84 exact rational metric/path envelope; for both endpoint |latitude|<=60deg the spherical central angle is also >=shorter longitude degrees/180, from haversine and sine concavity. Combine with latitude lower bound by maximum, never sum. Exact rational classification; unresolved intervals refuse. Scalar component check1e-6m is not independent inverse-geodesic parity.

model.scale_selection: Unselected prescribed sensitivity. Two training locals leave only one in inner site holdout, so bandwidth is not identifiable; neither Solsoe outcomes nor old target scores select a scale.
model.source_mask: Retain the exact existing common old-method source mask; inherited undefined draws are never rescued. Additional new-model refusals may narrow the defined population. Unselected signed ring0 and both-ring diagnostics remain authenticated source references, without a new ring0 positivity gate.
model.mean: Weighted square-root means, squared and normalized, using host zero-compatible Hellinger barycentre with unchanged source closure1e-9; no pseudocount, source renormalization, clipping or nearest fallback.
model.forward: Use matching original replicate index for local signed covers, regional cover and shared PPE. Regional_deposition=regional_cover*PPE*saved_forward_regional_k, PPE weighted exactly once; native forward uses saved localK/terrestrial fractions/PPE.
model.nominal_handoff: Before new model forecasts, reconstruct all three eligible original nominal baseline covers/pollen vectors from manifest-bound native selected-ring CSVs and regional CSV; compare unchanged absolute1e-12 and preserve all mismatches. Never invert rounded baseline covers to recover local fits.
model.unsupported_extrapolation: Distances exceed300km to the two training locals; finite normalized Gaussian arithmetic does not establish supported ecological interpolation.

uncertainty.reuse: Exact original same-index coupled count/PPE ensemble, no new RNG, inverse fits or kernel integration. Preserve shared regional/local dependencies and original scientific source parents.
uncertainty.summary: Undefined count/1024, refused unconditional moments if any undefined, finite-only empirical mean/covariance(ddof0)/linear quantiles0.025,0.5,0.975 and separate IID conditional-mean MCSE. These are conditional working-law diagnostics, not a posterior or calibrated field coverage.
uncertainty.other_targets: Reverse Swedish-block cases have admission-refused/not-executed status, not invented1024undefined model draws. All45 prior source nominal refusals remain in their original54-disposition account.

scoring.role_gate: Freeze/authenticate every new prediction before source-observation scoring-role access. Original sources were previously exposed; whole-file decoding/hash custody and other-fold ancestry do not establish globally unread outcomes or OS-enforced isolation. No target counts are passed to numerical prediction code.
scoring.targets: Only geography-admitted target roles; exact original2700–3200calBP/Betula-Ulmus counted denominator. No measured vegetation score.
scoring.comparison: Compare both fixed new profiles to the three retained physical/direct-pollen families on exactly common-defined replicate IDs per comparison. Retain undefined mass and all failures; no winner or acceptance threshold is inferred.
scoring.ancestry: Case-scoped original allowed_inputs and selected local/regional/PPE draw references are scientific parents. Whole original source/result/prediction/bank file hashes authenticate accounting only.

unsupported_claims: Multiple independently scored geographic blocks if only one is eligible
New raw source admission or human endorsement
